items.content: SCENE: A bright, rain-flecked urban Indian doorstep at golden hour just after a monsoon shower, wet pavement reflecting warm light. SUBJECT: A confident local service professional (electrician/plumber, gender-neutral set, mid-20s to 30s, real Indian features, neat work uniform) holding a toolkit, mid-stride toward a home. PHONE-UI MOCKUP: floating to the right, a clean QckServe app card showing a service listing — service name, “₹0 to list” badge, “Zero commission” pill, and a green “Contact owner directly” button; crisp, modern, rounded 14px corners. COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking only, no gradients — QckServe orange #ef6723 and #FF6B00 accents, deep charcoal #1A1A1A, soft off-white #FCF9F8; one accent used sparingly. LIGHTING: warm directional golden-hour key with soft rim light off wet surfaces, gentle ambient fill. TYPE HIERARCHY: oversized extra-bold condensed headline space reserved upper area, smaller italic-serif kicker beneath — keep type minimal, leave room for real text overlay. EYE FLOW: top-left logo zone → headline → pro’s face → phone-UI card → CTA. CAMERA: 35mm, slight low angle, f/2.0 shallow depth, editorial product-marketing feel. PERFORMANCE LAYER: thumb-stopping contrast, high clarity at small sizes, clean negative space for caption.
